aliasConflicts.kimi: local canonical LLM provider id (open-sse/providers/registry/kimi.js) whose searchViaChat already serves chat-wrapped web search; do not remap it to kimi-search

exports.index.js: public staging exports (config.js, adapter.js except invalid, service.js)

auth.identity: selected connection only; no credential mutation, cache, refresh, replay, chat fallback or failover

envelope.request: { text_query: NFKC/trimmed/collapsed query, limit: min(max_results ?? 5, 20), include_content: true }
envelope.response: { provider: 'kimi-search', query, results: SearchResult[] (local normalizers.js makeResult shape), answer: null, usage: { queries_used: 1, search_cost_usd }, metrics, errors: [] } rebuilt from validated search_results[]

integration.provider: new open-sse/providers/registry/kimi-search.js from kimiSearchProviderDefinition (category apikey, serviceKinds ['webSearch'], searchConfig), plus alias 'moonshot'; the existing kimi.js transport/auth/searchViaChat stay unchanged
integration.search: open-sse/handlers/search/index.js handleSearchCore: dispatch handleKimiSearchNative for provider 'kimi-search' before tryDedicatedProvider; or add a 'kimi-search' builder to handlers/search/callers.js and normalizer to handlers/search/normalizers.js (the generic path would then lose input refusal, result URL filtering and acceptedJob)
integration.route: src/app/api/v1/search route + provider resolution must map 'moonshot' to 'kimi-search' and enforce blockedProviders on the resolved id (OmniRoute #20276)
integration.accounting: result.accounting stays costStatus unknown; data.usage.search_cost_usd is the registry list price for non-empty calls; acceptedJob marks possibly-billed failures
integration.catalog: docs/providers/catalog.mdx and shared catalogs updated at serial registration only

restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions
search_type 'web' only; country, language, time_range, offset, domain_filter, content_options, provider_options and unknown fields are refused before submission (the source silently ignores them)
max_results positive integer, clamped to 20; query at most 2000 characters after normalization, no control characters
results without a public http(s) URL (private/loopback/metadata hosts, userinfo, other schemes) are dropped; results capped to limit
non-object envelope or missing/non-array search_results is a malformed 502 (the source returns zero results)
10s default / 15s maximum total deadline, 8MiB success and 16KiB error response bounds
upstream error messages and bodies are never relayed
no answer synthesis, no streaming, no model discovery (the source exposes none for this provider)
